elements.contents: ... that La Querida in Palm Beach, Florida, served as the Winter White House for President John F. Kennedy?

elements.title: Tudor City (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that residents of Tudor City once put themselves in front of a bulldozer to prevent a park there from being demolished?

elements.title: an ancient roof tile (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: abortion in the United Arab Emirates (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that abortion in the United Arab Emirates has been described by Newsweek as less restrictive than some American states following the overturning of Roe v. Wade?

elements.title: Susan Botti (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that opera singer Susan Botti performed an Olympic jingle for Kodak to pay for graduate school?
